===Objectives===
* Give the [[Experimental Elixir (item)|experimental elixir]] to [[Fadden Hathorn]] in [[Sardelac Sanitarium]].
* See [[Vassar]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* {{skill icon|Shatter Hex}}

==Walkthrough==
Just map travel and follow the objectives; there are no challenges involved.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;[[Erudine]]
:''My elixir experiment has progressed rapidly beyond expectations, and I believe it is ready for a field test. In Sardelac Sanitarium there is a poor man named [[Fadden Hathorn]], who was a bit addled by the events of the Searing. He is suffering from a condition that causes him to see giant sentient devourer eggs attacking him. It's quite fascinating, actually. I believe my elixir can help him regain his sanity, if not cure him outright.''

:''Would you be so kind as to give him my [[Experimental Elixir (item)|elixir]] and then report your findings to my colleague, [[Vassar]]?''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I will give him your elixir.
| decline = I have more serious matters to addend to.
| ask = Please administer my [[Experimental Elixir (item)|experimental elixir]] to [[Fadden Hathorn]] in Sardelac Sanitarium. Report to [[Vassar]] when you are finished.
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Fadden Hathorn
:''Drink this? If you'll promise it'll make them go away, then I will…''

:''''Who… How did I get here?  Where am I? This looks like Ashford Abbey… but what in the name of Dwayna has happened? I feel as if I've awakened from a long nightmare.''

===Reward dialogue===
;Vassar
:''So, Erudine's elixir worked?  This is wonderful news.  We can begin helping some of the poor souls who have been guests here since the Searing.  I am continually amazed at your resourcefulness, «name».''
